title: still present since round 4: Aoife's baked PDF still hides her phone (employer-email half fixed)
evidence: base_row: `phone: None,` — row_aoife() overrides address/employer/refs/pets but never phone; client fixture: `\"phone\":\"087 123 4567\"` in app_aoife_json; pdftotext of the baked PDF shows her contact block as `aoife.ni.riain@example.ie / Phone / Not provided` (grep for "087 123 4567" in report-a-aoife.pdf text: no match).
detail: The client fixture carries Aoife's phone but the shipped PDF prints 'Not provided' — the showcase report contradicts the in-app detail page.

title: still present since round 4: pdf_prebake regen docs promise a positional CLI arg that main() never reads (RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR env is the real switch)
evidence: header: `//// Regenerate (after fixture craft changes): / ////   gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake -- server/priv / ////   (cwd = server/; the arg is the priv dir. Defaults to "priv" relative / ////    to the server package root.)` — main(): `let priv_dir = case envoy.get("RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR") { Ok(dir) -> dir Error(_) -> "priv" }` with comment `// documented regen: `RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR=priv gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake` from the server root`.
detail: Running the documented `-- server/priv` form silently ignores the arg and writes to ./priv relative to cwd — PDFs land in the wrong tree with a success message.
recommended_fix: Make the header document only RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR (or actually read argv).

title: still present since round 4: seed_error_from_result discards the DecodeError — the drift guard can't say which fixture/field rotted
evidence: `pub fn seed_error_from_result( result: Result(a, json.DecodeError), ) -> Result(a, SeedError) { case result { Ok(value) -> Ok(value) Error(_) -> Error(SeedError("demo fixture decode failed")) } }`
detail: Every decode failure collapses to one generic message; the failing fixture, path and expected/found shape are lost in both test output and runtime.
recommended_fix: Carry json.DecodeError's path/expected into SeedError (or keep the DecodeError type).

title: still present since round 4: maples/harbour fixtures: created_at + validity_days != closes_at (36d vs 14d; 31d vs 21d — Sunningdale's 30d checks out)
evidence: v-maples: `\"validity_days\":14 ... \"created_at\":\"2026-07-20T10:00:00Z\",\"closes_at\":\"2026-08-25T23:59:00Z\"` (created+14d = 08-03, closes 08-25 = 36d); v-harbour: `\"validity_days\":21 ... \"created_at\":\"2026-08-02T14:30:00Z\",\"closes_at\":\"2026-09-02T23:59:00Z\"` (created+21d = 08-23, closes 09-02 = 31d); v-sunningdale: created 06-15 + 30d = closes 07-15 ✓ — while demo_store.create_vacancy derives `let closes_at = add_days_iso(now, payload.validity_days)`.
detail: The fixtures violate the exact arithmetic the store's own create path enforces; the demo shows vacancies whose listing window predates their creation story.
recommended_fix: Reconcile created_at/closes_at with validity_days in the two fixtures (or widen the story deliberately).

title: still present since round 4: report_download_test pins the id mapping but not baked-asset presence — a deleted/misnamed PDF 404s silently
evidence: `pub fn every_baked_report_has_a_matching_analysis_test() { let pairs = demo_store.report_filenames() list.length(pairs) |> should.equal(8) list.each(pairs, fn(pair) { let analysis_id = "an-" <> string.drop_start(pair.0, 2) demo_api.application_id_from_analysis(analysis_id) |> should.equal(pair.0) }) }` — report_filenames is a store-side literal; no check touches server/priv/static/demo/ on disk.
detail: Deleting or renaming a committed report-*.pdf keeps the suite green; every demo download of that applicant 404s in production.
recommended_fix: Add a check that each report_filenames key has a non-empty server/priv/static/demo/report-<id>.pdf (test-side file read or CI ls).

title: still present since round 4: EXEMPT_ARMS trusts comments over code for 18 arms — removing a claimed guard keeps the lint green
evidence: comment: `# Message arms whose real api calls are structurally unreachable in demo mode / # (auth flows always exit the demo first; ApiReturnedSession/PolicyRefresh are / # demo-guarded at the top of their handlers).` then `EXEMPT_ARMS = { "ApiReturnedLogin", ... detail: Deleting the ApiReturnedSession/PolicyRefresh demo guards (the r4 W9 class) or adding an auth api call to any exempted arm passes the lint.

title: still present since round 4: manifest matcher counts any capitalized constructor line in handle bodies as 'handled' (theoretical masking)
evidence: `m = re.match(r"^([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]+)(\(| ->| \||$)", stripped) if m: handled.add(m.group(1))` runs on every line inside handle's case — nested arm lines like `RefcheckSkip -> fire_demo_refcheck(model, call_id, "skip")` and `RefcheckEditSubstitute -> {` add RefcheckSkip/RefcheckEditSubstitute to `handled` although they are inner patterns of UserChoseRefcheckAction/UserSavedRefcheckEdit, not top-level interceptions.
detail: A DEMO_INTERCEPTED entry that only ever appears as a nested constructor inside another arm's body would pass the manifest check without being intercepted.
recommended_fix: Track brace depth and only collect constructors at the case's top level.
